authority: unpack-probe.json remains the decision source; this file is corroboration only

probe.correctness: probe kernels are never evaluated against the task oracle; the two expand arms carry a full element-wise coverage check against the CPU decode
probe.coverage_method: Each expand producer writes the exact +-1 decode of every packed word into scratch[K, N]. After a timed run the probe reads the whole scratch back and requires element-wise equality with the CPU decode of the same words (uint16 half bits for fp16/packed16, float32 for fp32). The packed and all three shared GEMM arms receive the same bits and x=1 and must produce identical y.

traffic.note: packed word reads are L2-resident (the whole packed matrix is 2 MiB at paper); the fp32 producer issues 4 B of word reads per decoded element because it decodes four elements per thread. consumer_b_read_bytes counts the expanded matrix re-read by every output row block. packed_read_bytes counts distinct words; the REG candidate issues one word per lane pair (paper) or lane quad (small), so packed_read_bytes_issued is the number of bytes the hardware is actually asked for.

supersedes.r1_defect: every GEMM arm staged B with four uint4 passes per thread, so it wrote 64 k rows into a BLOCK_K=32-row threadgroup region (2296 halves = 4592 B past the declared array) and read the expanded matrix twice per k step. r1 is kept verbatim as unpack-probe-r1-superseded.json and is not used for the decision.
supersedes.r2_fix: the pass count is derived from BLOCK_K*BLOCK_N and recorded as b_staging_audit

purpose: Replay of the same probe on the same machine, archived to show which comparisons are stable and which are noise-limited. The REG arm and the paper ranking reproduce; the two cheapest legal SHARED forms are indistinguishable at small, so no ordering is claimed there.
